title: Allow OpenLane heuristic diode insertion as a P&R knob
decision: New allowed knob RUN_HEURISTIC_DIODE_INSERTION (0/1, default 0); iteration 4 = iteration 3 + diodes on, from routing.
rationale: Orion escalated: one antenna net (net34, ratio 1.03) survived repair iterations 3->6 and margin 10->20%.

title: Do not start a P&R iteration that cannot finish within the tool budget
decision: Final iteration (option A) not started at 14/16 tool runs: a placement iteration stops after CTS, a routing-only one after the DRV check.
rationale: The meter stops the task right after the run that reaches the limit; any started iteration would spend 2 runs with no result.

title: Raise the place_route tool-run budget 16 -> 20 for one final iteration
decision: Iteration 5 = iteration 3 parameters, heuristic diodes off, placement density 55 -> 60 %, antenna margin 20 -> 30 % (analyzer's choice in range), from placement.
rationale: Iteration 4's heuristic diodes fixed the antenna but added ~2,550 diodes (clock fanout up to 25, 18 slew violations).

title: P&R budget ceiling 30, raised one iteration at a time, diagnosis checked against sources first
decision: Ceiling 30 tool runs; each raise only covers the next iteration; before every iteration the real problem is found from tool facts and checked against published sources; use as few runs as possible.

title: Stop P&R at 18/20: antenna violations come from detailed routing, which global-route repair cannot see
decision: No further iteration or budget raise; sync_fifo stays FAIL; change #2's RTL timing fix stands (+1.896 ns at +/-10%, what-if).
rationale: check_antennas -verbose on the global route: net19 met1 side ratio 476.73 vs allowed 2,736 (gate tied to driver diffusion on met1); after detailed routing the met1 piece is split from the driver, allowed 400. OpenLane 2.3.10 has no post-detailed-route repair; heuristic diodes cannot target the 141-188 um nets without a flood.
